kinds.hint: mismatch|differs|does not match|不一致|違う|ずれ|\blate\b|\bearly\b|遅れ|早い

items.look_for: a caption line whose words differ from what the voice says; either side may be wrong, the user decides
a caption that names something the picture does not show, or a picture that shows a value the caption does not carry
a caption that appears more than a second late or early, or stays after the next line is spoken

kinds.hint: overlap|hidden|hides|\bhid\b|cover|cut off|\bsmall\b|かぶ|重な|隠|覆|はみ出|切れ|小さ

items.look_for: an element that hides information: a caption over a figure's label, a countdown ring over a card's first letter, a lower third over a chart axis
text cut by the frame edge or outside the safe area
text too small to read at phone width; the leaf measures its height in pixel rows and names the threshold
a word on screen or in a caption that is misspelt or mistyped
a caption word converted to the wrong homophone (誤変換): the kanji does not fit the meaning the voice carries
the same term written two ways across captions or episodes (表記ゆれ); a number or unit format that differs from the rest

kinds.hint: \bdB\b|\bst\b|prosody|pitch|\blevel\b|音量|高さ|抑揚|緩急|跳|間が|空白|無音|buried|埋も|\bfast\b|速

items.look_for: a pitch or level jump inside one caption line against the previous segment
speech the captions do not carry
a passage the music or an effect covers so the words cannot be made out
a line read clearly faster or slower than the same speaker's other lines (morae per second)
no pause at a 。 inside a line, or a pause inside a line long enough to break the sentence
a line with far less pitch movement than the same speaker's other lines
a number, unit or date read as another value (1040 as 1400; 万 and 億 swapped)
a person, company or product name read wrongly or with an accent that changes it
a Latin-script or loan term read letter by letter or as another word
a kanji word read with the wrong reading where the meaning changes
a word whose pitch accent differs from the dictionary's (一番 read level instead of イチ↓バン); the dictionary is unreliable on loanwords and compounds, so this is always for the ear

kinds.hint: 一次情報|出典|公式|発表|報道|統計|source|official|first-party|年が|年は|数が|refut|言い過ぎ

items.look_for: a figure, date, rank or share a first-party source does not support (tier A)
a quote, decision or intent attributed to a real person or company that sources do not support (tier B)
a claim worded stronger than its source allows

kinds.hint: 図|絵|動き|コマ|フレーム|カウンタ|波|矢印|アニメ|指の本数|手の指|融合|貫通|文字化け|\bmotion\b|\bframes?\b|\bdiagram\b|\bcounter\b|\bfigures?\b|\bfingers?\b|\bhands?\b|\blimbs?\b|\bmerged?\b|\bpseudo|\bglitch

items.look_for: a diagram, counter or animated number whose value, direction or order does not match the caption or the voice
a drawn hand with the wrong number of fingers or an impossible grip
a figure with a missing, extra or wrongly bent limb, or a face with misplaced parts
objects fused into each other or passing through each other
letter-like marks in the picture that spell nothing, or a logo or sign with wrong letters
a broken or skipped frame, a flash, or an element that pops in without motion
a step the explanation skips so the next one cannot be followed
a term used before it is defined, or never defined
a "last time" or "as shown" reference that names the wrong episode or moment
at the reduced size (168 px) the thumbnail does not tell which topic it is
its text is not legible at the reduced size
its text differs from the intended title
a drawn portrait of a real person with a drawing defect: hands, limbs, face parts, merged objects
whether the portrait looks like the person; the user's call, prepared with the reference photos beside each frame
